justifications.unit: The generator is exercised end to end by CodeGeneratorTests; measured 100% of coverable lines.
justifications.guard: Internal static generation helpers take options objects, no public null-check guards to exercise; no guard tests exist for this file.

justifications.unit: Unit tests scaffold every template with each database, caching and transport option plus the unknown-option, non-empty-directory and error paths, so nearly every line is reachable.
justifications.guard: The guard suite also scaffolds every template and every provider option end to end, so it reaches most of the file beyond the argument checks.
justifications.integration: The Roslyn compilation test runs CreateProjectAsync for the api, worker and console templates with default options, so it covers the template generators but not the provider-option or error branches.
